gloss: fine piece of music; excellent song

definitions.gloss: fine piece of music; excellent song; good composition
definitions.explanation: A musical piece of high quality or artistic merit. A somewhat formal and appreciative term used in music criticism and reviews to praise a composition without the superlative force of 'masterpiece.'

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{佳曲|かきょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This album has many fine songs.

examples.english: Among his early works, there are many fine pieces that have not faded with time.

notes:
Composed of {佳|か} (good, fine, beautiful) and ⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧ (piece of music, tune). The character {佳|か} implies refined, understated quality rather than overwhelming greatness. This word is frequently used in music reviews, liner notes, and critical writing. It carries a tone of genuine but measured praise.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{隠|かく}れた→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧{佳曲|かきょく}: hidden gem (in music)
- {佳曲|かきょく}{揃|ぞろ}い: full of fine songs
- ⟦{知|し}られざる→知る：00458_shiru⟧{佳曲|かきょく}: an unknown fine piece

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{名曲|めいきょく}→名曲：17476_meikyoku⟧: masterpiece, famous piece — implies greater fame and recognition
- {良曲|りょうきょく}: good song — more casual and used more in informal online discussion
- {秀曲|しゅうきょく}: excellent piece — emphasizes outstanding quality; rarer
